Bernds-tech/WellFit.note: Graphical/UI/UX authority. Much current product UI still physically lives in WellFit-now; migration is not yet accepted.

Bernds-tech/WellFit-now.note: Technical authority for web/backend/auth/data/APIs/mission/economy/server logic, security/runtime and general technical application/mobile logic outside the Buddy domain. It still contains graphical/UI code and Buddy-specific Unity AR code pending explicit migration.

Bernds-tech/WellFit-Buddy.note: Buddy authority: Buddy behavior, presentation/animation and Buddy-specific AR/camera interaction. General technical mobile/application ownership remains in WellFit-now.

repo_memory_alignment.evidence: Roles are now explicit and consistent, but physical code ownership still differs from final domain ownership.

cross_repo_contracts.evidence: Technical authority is substantially implemented; graphical and Buddy consumer contracts plus physical ownership migration remain incomplete.

integration_e2e.evidence: No exact-version graphical + technical + Buddy end-to-end mission/Buddy journey is accepted.

convergence_readiness.evidence: Roles are fixed; actual graphical and Buddy code still partly resides in WellFit-now and migration is not accepted.

real_program_truth: WellFit-now is the technical product authority and currently the physical primary codebase.
WellFit-Buddy is the Buddy authority, not the owner of all general technical mobile application logic.
Closed-Beta auth/session hardening, server-authoritative missions/economy, Buddy backend and global-location foundations exist in WellFit-now.
The Unity Buddy AR project exists under WellFit-now/native/unity/WellFitBuddyAR and remains real-device unaccepted.
The three repositories may later converge; no final target or timing has been chosen.
rules: This file is the only WellFit program-level memory authority while the three repositories remain separate.
Local repositories own their domain truth; this master owns only cross-repository coordination truth.
WellFit = graphics/UI/UX; WellFit-now = technical product; WellFit-Buddy = Buddy domain.
A local accepted state does not imply cross-repository integration acceptance.
No convergence target, date or strategy may be inferred before an explicit reviewed decision.
Always distinguish intended repository ownership from current physical code location.
General technical mobile/application logic follows WellFit-now unless it is specifically Buddy behavior, Buddy presentation/animation or Buddy-specific AR/camera interaction.
